description: Values for a ?next= / ?returnTo= / redirect_uri parameter. Your validator decides what goes into the Location header.
convention: Rejected = throws, or returns false/null/undefined. If it returns true, the original input is used as the Location. If it returns a string, that string is used as the Location.
oracle: The Location value is resolved the way a browser does (WHATWG URL, relative to current_url). An attack passes if it is rejected or the destination is http(s) on an allowed origin. A legit input passes if it is accepted and lands on the expected destination.
